answer_1.quote: Multi-aspect Controllable Text Generation aims to generate fluent text with a combination of attributes from diverse aspects (e.g. sentiment, topic, tense, person, and stuff).
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences conditioned on specified attribute combinations

answer_2.quote: We adopt the evaluation metrics ... 1) ACC i.d. and ACC comp : the averaged prediction accuracies ... 2) PPL i.d. and PPL comp : perplexity ... 3) Dist-3: 3-gram distinctness to evaluate the diversity of the text generated ...

answer_4.quote: For each dataset and baseline in each protocol (Original, HoldOut, and ACD), we randomly sample 10 texts ... and employ three annotators to score them on the two metrics on a scale from 1 (very bad) to 5 (very good).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score Relevance (alignment with desired attribute combination) and Fluency (grammatical correctness and readability) on a 1‑5 scale.
